# Tabler (Open Source)

- Source: https://tabler.io/admin-template (GitHub: https://github.com/tabler/tabler)
- Package: `@tabler/core` 1.7.3, downloaded from npm on 10 November 2026; see ../../../docs/TABLER-UI.md for how it is used
- License: MIT (the free Open Source edition; the paid Pro packages are not used)
- Included files: `css/` (tabler, themes, vendors), `js/` (tabler, theme), `libs/apexcharts/` (ApexCharts bundled with Tabler, with its license)

Usage in an HTML page:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="vendor/tabler/css/tabler.min.css" />
<script src="vendor/tabler/libs/apexcharts/apexcharts.min.js"></script>
<script src="vendor/tabler/js/tabler.min.js"></script>
```
